optimization.name: real-erf
optimization.description: Replace the real-valued DERF1 wrapper around complex CERROR with standard intrinsic ERF(x); CERROR and all other source bytes remain unchanged
optimization.before:
real*8 function DERF1(x)
     real*8 x
     complex*16 zg,zgg 
!      y=DERF(x)
      zg=x
      call cerror(zg,zgg)
      DERF1=zgg
     return
     end
optimization.after:
real*8 function DERF1(x)
     real*8 x
      DERF1=ERF(x)
     return
     end
optimization.diff:
--- DERF1.original
+++ DERF1.real-erf
@@ -1,9 +1,5 @@
      real*8 function DERF1(x)
      real*8 x
-     complex*16 zg,zgg 
-!      y=DERF(x)
-      zg=x
-      call cerror(zg,zgg)
-      DERF1=zgg
+      DERF1=ERF(x)
      return
      end

source.output_instrumentation: Write every internal PDF point; remove duplicate first-point write; no arithmetic changes.
